findings.current: I was informed in advance that you were coming. This way, please.
findings.defect: Omits that the people who arrived earlier gave the Captain the advance notice.
findings.rationale: 앞서 오신 분들 identifies the source of the information.
findings.replacement: Those who arrived before you told me to expect you. This way, please.
findings.source: 앞서 오신 분들께 미리 언질을 들었습니다. 우선 이리로.

findings.current: Taishan giggled at the tickling while Namho prepared to unleash a torrent of curses at him. Then they both looked at the Captain of the Guards and gave him an awkward laugh.
findings.defect: Makes both men laugh at the Captain; only Namho does. Taishan is laughing because he is ticklish.
findings.rationale: 남호가 is the subject of the laugh directed at the Captain.
findings.replacement: Taishan giggled at the tickling. Namho was about to unleash a torrent of curses at him, but instead gave the Captain of the Guards, who was watching him, a hearty laugh.
findings.source: 간지러움에 꺄르르 웃는 태산과, 그런 녀석에게 한바탕 쌍욕을 퍼부으려던 남호가 자신을 응시하는 호위장을 향해 허허 웃어 보였다.

findings.current: If the bastard who used those expensive night-shining pearls was the City Lord who just died, then at least he died well.
findings.defect: “Died well” suggests a good manner of death rather than Namho’s contemptuous approval that the man is dead.
findings.rationale: 잘 뒈졌군 is a hostile judgment about the death, not a description of how he died.
findings.replacement: If the bastard who put up those expensive night-shining pearls was the City Lord who just died, then good riddance to him.
findings.source: 저 값비싼 야명주를 쓴 미친놈이 이번에 죽은 성주라면, 그럭저럭 잘 뒈졌군.

findings.current: When I saw Namho let his guard down and show this side of himself, I could tell he really did have years of experience behind him.
findings.defect: Adds that Namho lets his guard down; the source says his experience occasionally shows through.
findings.rationale: 슬쩍 내비치는 describes a subtle glimpse, not a lapse in vigilance.
findings.replacement: Whenever Namho let this side of himself show, even for a moment, I could tell he had years of experience behind him.
findings.source: 간혹 남호가 슬쩍 내비치는 이런 모습들을 보면 확실히 짬밥이라는 게 있구나 싶다.

findings.current: Do you have to taste-test shit to know it isn’t soybean paste?
findings.defect: Soybean paste is not 춘장, weakening the comparison behind the joke.
findings.rationale: 춘장 is the dark sauce used for jjajangmyeon; its appearance makes the comparison work.
findings.replacement: Do you have to taste shit to tell it from black bean sauce?
findings.source: 똥인지 춘장인지 꼭 찍어 먹어 봐야 압니까?

findings.current: That was how long it took us to reach the City Lord’s residence—the City Lord’s residence and government offices, known as the City Lord’s Hall.
findings.defect: Repeats “the City Lord’s residence” and obscures the building’s dual purpose.
findings.rationale: 거처인 동시에 관청 states those two functions once.
findings.replacement: That was how long it took us to reach the City Lord’s Hall, which served as both his residence and his government offices.
findings.source: 우리가 사천성주의 거처인 동시에 관청인 성주부(星州府)에 도착하기까지 걸린 시간이었다.

summary: The draft has one changed subject and several losses of meaning or tone.
